role.en: Grandmother, the First Mother of the daykeepers
role.zh: 祖母，日守者的第一母親

blurb.en: Grinds the maize that becomes human flesh; reads omens, weaves, and outlives every generation she makes.
blurb.zh: 磨出化為人肉的玉米；讀兆、織布，活過她所造的每一代。

quip.en: Nine grindings; that is what a person is.
quip.zh: 磨九次；人就是這麼來的。

role.en: Grandfather, the First Father and daykeeper
role.zh: 祖父，第一父親與日守者

blurb.en: Counts the days before the world exists; casts the beans and the corn kernels to decide what may be made.
blurb.zh: 在世界存在之前即數算日子；擲豆與玉米粒以決定何者可造。

quip.en: Ask the day before you ask the gods.
quip.zh: 先問日子，再問神明。

role.en: One of the Hero Twins, blowgunner

blurb.en: Kills Seven Macaw and loses a head to Camazotz; keeps his humor even as a squashed squash.
blurb.zh: 射殺七鸚鵡，頭顱被卡馬佐茲剪去；即使頭換成葫蘆也保持幽默。

quip.en: Take the head; the game needs an audience.
quip.zh: 頭拿去；遊戲總要有觀眾。

role.en: One of the Hero Twins, the younger

blurb.en: The quieter trickster: replaces his brother's head with a tortilla, sings the fatal dances, and rises as the moon.
blurb.zh: 更沉靜的機巧者：以玉米餅換回兄長之頭，唱出致命之舞，升為月亮。

quip.en: Never tell them all of it.
quip.zh: 永遠不要全盤托出。

role.en: Father of the Hero Twins, ballplayer

blurb.en: Plays the ballgame too loudly for the underworld's comfort; dies on the sacrificial stone before the true game begins.
blurb.zh: 球聲吵擾冥府；在真正的比賽開始前，死於祭石之上。

quip.en: They heard the ball before they heard us.
quip.zh: 他們先聽見球，才聽見我們。

role.en: Twin brother of One Hunahpú

blurb.en: Goes down the dark roads beside his brother and is buried with him at the ballcourt of Xibalbá.
blurb.zh: 與兄弟同下冥府暗路，同葬於希巴爾巴的球場。

quip.en: Wherever he went, I went too.
quip.zh: 他去哪裡，我便跟到哪裡。

role.en: Blood Maiden, daughter of a lord of Xibalbá
role.zh: 血女，希巴爾巴諸主之女

blurb.en: Draws blood from a gourd tree and conceives the Hero Twins; outruns her father's tribunal to be born as their mother.
blurb.zh: 自葫蘆樹取得血而懷英雄雙子；逃過父親的審判，成為他們的母親。

quip.en: I came for fruit; the fruit came into me.
quip.zh: 我來摘果；果子卻進了我身。

role.en: Seven Macaw, the false sun

blurb.en: Hangs in a nance tree, boasts of the dawn, and wears metal teeth he cannot afford; loses both teeth and eyes to two boys with a blowgun.
blurb.zh: 懸於南美櫻桃樹，自誇黎明，戴著買不起的金牙；被兩個吹箭男孩奪去牙與眼。

quip.en: I am the dawn. Look at my teeth.
quip.zh: 我即黎明。看看我的牙。

role.en: Maker of mountains, son of Seven Macaw

blurb.en: Survives the pit meant to bury him, carries the 400 boys' house down on them, and drowns proving he can catch a crab by hand.
blurb.zh: 從欲埋他的坑中倖存，令四百男孩的屋子塌落壓死他們；又為徒手捉蟹而溺亡。

quip.en: I carry mountains. You carry gossip.
quip.zh: 我搬得動山；你們只搬得動流言。

role.en: Shaker of mountains, second son of Seven Macaw

blurb.en: Topples the earth's ridges for pride; eats a poisoned lure-bird and is pinned under the mountains he loved to move.
blurb.zh: 因傲而掀翻大地山脊；食下毒鳥，被他最愛搖動的山所壓斃。

quip.en: The hills will move for me.
quip.zh: 群山必為我而動。

role.en: Elder stepbrother of the twins, flute player

blurb.en: Skilled in music and painting, jealous in the garden; goes up a tree for the game birds and comes down a howler monkey.
blurb.zh: 擅音樂繪畫，忌於園圃；為捉鳥爬上樹，落地時已成吼猴。

quip.en: They were painting and singing. We were clearing.
quip.zh: 他們繪畫歌唱；我們卻在墾地。

role.en: Elder stepbrother of the twins

blurb.en: Climbs with Hun Batz and cannot get down; becomes a monkey artist that the forest still humors.
blurb.zh: 與洪·巴茲同上樹而不得下；化為林間仍被容忍的猴畫家。

quip.en: The tree was taller this morning.
quip.zh: 今晨的樹格外高了。

role.en: Death Bat of the House of Bats

blurb.en: Comes down at noon to look for the dawn and snips off a head as cleanly as a leaf; the one lord the twins never outplay.
blurb.zh: 正午飛下尋覓黎明，剪首如剪葉；是雙子唯一未曾勝過的主人。

quip.en: Heads are fruit to me.
quip.zh: 於我，人頭如瓜果。

role.en: Senior lord of Xibalbá beside Seven Death
role.zh: 希巴爾巴首主，與七死神並列

blurb.en: Sets the fine print of every house and every game; dies believing in the twin performers' act.
blurb.zh: 為每座屋與每場遊戲立下細則；因相信雙子的表演而死。

quip.en: Dance again; we shall do it properly.
quip.zh: 再跳一次；這次按規矩來。

role.en: Sovereign Plumed Serpent, co-framer of the world
role.zh: 羽蛇主宰，世界的共同塑造者

blurb.en: Speaks in the darkness with Heart of Sky and the Framer; thinks the earth, then rests it, then populates it.
blurb.zh: 在黑暗中與天之心、塑造者共語；以思想立地，而後使其安定、繁衍。

quip.en: It was thought; therefore it stands.
quip.zh: 既已思想；故而屹立。

role.en: The Framer and Shaper of the sky-earth

blurb.en: Names everything first; keeps the register of what was spoken and what must be unmade.
blurb.zh: 最先為萬物命名；記存所言與當毀者。

quip.en: Say it once; I will remember it.
quip.zh: 說一次就好；我會記住。

role.en: Patron god of the K'iche', giver of fire

blurb.en: Walks unseen among the first men, provides fire through rain, and prices every flame in blood and hearts.
blurb.zh: 隱形行走於初民之間，於雨中賜火；每一簇火焰皆以血與心為價。

quip.en: Warm your hands; bring me a heart.
quip.zh: 暖了手，便帶心來。

role.en: Jaguar Smoking Shadow, first ancestor of the K'iche'
role.zh: 豹煙影，基切的第一祖先

blurb.en: Made of ground maize, married, marched, and carried the bundle of the unseen god down the generations.
blurb.zh: 以磨碎玉米所造；娶妻、遷徙，將隱形之神的神像包束代代相傳。

quip.en: We are what was ground for us.
quip.zh: 我們即是為我們磨成的。

role.en: Night Jaguar, ancestor of the Ah-Acab lineage

blurb.en: Takes Night Jaguar as his god and his wife and founds his line in the dark part of the council.
blurb.zh: 以夜豹為神為妻，於議事之暗處開創其族。

quip.en: My part of the night has its own fire.
quip.zh: 我那半邊黑夜自有其火。

role.en: Not-Right-Now Jaguar, ancestor of the Ilom lineage
role.zh: 非即刻之豹，伊洛姆氏族之祖

blurb.en: Third maize-made ancestor; keeps the count of days and the old speeches for his descendants.
blurb.zh: 玉米所造第三祖先；為後代保存日數與古語。

quip.en: Count the days; the line counts itself.
quip.zh: 數日子吧；族系自會延續。

role.en: Moon Jaguar, fourth ancestor, without issue

blurb.en: Does not marry; his part is substance, not succession, and he goes into the count of days.
blurb.zh: 不娶；其分不在傳承而在本質，終歸入日數之中。

quip.en: The moon needs no children.
quip.zh: 月亮不需要子嗣。

role.en: Feathered Serpent, ruler and culture bringer of the Itzá
role.zh: 羽蛇，伊察的統治者與文明帶來者

blurb.en: Comes from the west, builds Chichén Itzá, names cities, and leaves by way of the sea; the serpent that a dynasty stands on.
blurb.zh: 自西方而來，建奇欽伊察，為諸城命名，後經海而去；王朝所立的蛇。

quip.en: I build a city and leave a calendar.
quip.zh: 我建一城，留一曆。

role.en: Zamná, old god of the sky, healer and inventor
role.zh: 扎姆納，天空老神，醫者與發明者

blurb.en: Invented writing and the calendar, healed the sick without cost, and taught the Yucatec to be human.
blurb.zh: 發明文字與曆法，不收分文醫治病人，教猶加敦人為人。

quip.en: I gave you letters and medicine; use both.
quip.zh: 文字與醫藥皆我所授；兩者都用。

role.en: Rain god with fourfold form

blurb.en: Lightning axe in hand, he opens the sky in four directions; every rain petition is a negotiation with him.
blurb.zh: 手持雷斧，於四方開天；每一次祈雨都是與他的談判。

quip.en: Ask properly; I water properly.
quip.zh: 請得合禮，我便落得合時。

role.en: Goddess of the moon, weaving, and childbirth

blurb.en: Old weaver of the night sky and midwife of the world; sends the tides and the twins of the loom.
blurb.zh: 夜空的織布老嫗，世界的產婆；遣潮汐，亦遣織機上的雙線。

quip.en: Everything woven must come loose.
quip.zh: 凡所織者，終須解開。

role.en: Earthquake lord of the Lacandón underworld
role.zh: 拉坎敦冥府的地震之主

blurb.en: Wants the sky to fall and the world to end; forbidden from touching the sun and furious about it.
blurb.zh: 欲使天崩世滅；被禁不得觸日，怒火中燒。

quip.en: One day I will kick the sky down.
quip.zh: 總有一天我要把天踢塌。

role.en: True God, chief of the Lacandón gods

blurb.en: Created the world after the failed attempts, made the Lacandones from corn, and assigned each god his duty and limit.
blurb.zh: 於嘗試失敗後創世，以玉米造拉坎敦人，並為諸神各派職司與限制。

quip.en: Each god may have one mischief. Not two.
quip.zh: 諸神各許一惡。不得其二。

role.en: Fire Mountain, founding leader of the Cakchiquel
role.zh: 火山，卡克奇克爾的開族首領

blurb.en: Led the tribes out of Tulán, spoke with the voice of the obsidian stone, and named the crossing of the sea as the birth of his people.
blurb.zh: 率諸族出圖蘭，以黑曜石之聲言事，將渡海之舉定為族群之誕生。

quip.en: A people is born where it crosses.
quip.zh: 族群誕生於其渡越之處。

role.en: White Cane, cofounder of the Cakchiquel line
role.zh: 白杖，卡克奇克爾的共創者

blurb.en: Shares the leadership and the speeches with Gagavitz; carries the rites that hold the two divisions of the tribe together.
blurb.zh: 與加加維茨共掌領導與講辭；執持使部落兩部凝聚的儀式。

quip.en: He speaks fire; I carry the staff.
quip.zh: 他言火；我執杖。

role.en: Jaguar Priest, prophet of the Yucatec

blurb.en: Speaks in katun riddles a cycle before their hour; his answers keep the calendar alive under Spanish rule.
blurb.zh: 以卡特倫謎語預言一個週期之前的事；其答語在西班牙統治下使曆法延續。

quip.en: Ask the katun; it knows you first.
quip.zh: 問卡特倫吧；它先認得你。
